data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6107 reported net prior year releases of $11.6 million in 2016, primarily due to a continued low level of insured natural catastrophe losses over the past two years (2014 and 2015 underwriting years). Additionally, the 2013 year of account closed with a surplus of $1.67 million. The syndicate's largest current year loss was Hurricane Matthew, which was contained within catastrophe margins.
